scenarios.prompt: A vendor sells an item for a gameplay wallet with stock and a timed discount. Define stable offer identity, price version and exactly-once grant.

criteria.price: Offer ID, price/wallet, availability, stock and validity window are explicit.
criteria.ownership: currency-dual charges wallets and entitlement-grant handles real-money ownership.
criteria.evidence: Balance, stock, expiry, duplicate callback and price-version boundaries reconcile.
